q: What are your timings on Sunday?
text: On Sunday we are open 10:00 am to 2:00 pm, emergencies only.

q: What time do you close on Wednesday?
text: We're open 9:00 am to 8:00 pm on Wednesday.

q: Are you open on public holidays?
text: We're Closed on public holidays, but the emergency line is open.

q: Is the front desk open during lunch time?
text: The front desk is closed from 1:30 pm to 2:30 pm for lunch, though doctors are available for booked patients during that time.

q: How much does teeth whitening cost?
text: Teeth whitening costs Rs 8,000 and takes 60 minutes. Let me know if you'd like to book an appointment.

q: What is the price of a dental implant?
text: A dental implant is Rs 28,000 per tooth, and the crown cost is separate. Let us know if you'd like to book a consultation.

q: How much do metal braces cost?
text: Braces (metal): Rs 35,000 to Rs 60,000. Doctor decides after a check. Answered from the clinic file

q: What is your consultation fee?
text: Consultation: Rs 400. Adjusted against treatment if you start within 7 days. Answered from the clinic file

q: Who is your orthodontist and which days is he in?
text: Dr. Imran Qureshi is our orthodontist, and he sees patients on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday. Would you like me to help you book a visit?

q: Which doctor does root canals?
text: Dr. Meera Nair handles root canals and sees patients Monday to Saturday. Would you like help booking an appointment?

q: If I cancel my appointment, is there a charge?
text: I am not sure about that, and I will not guess. I have passed your question to our team, and someone will call you back within 2 working hours. Answered from the clinic file

q: Do you accept credit cards?
text: Yes, we accept credit cards, along with UPI, debit cards, and cash.

q: Can I pay for braces in EMI?
text: Yes, we offer Braces (metal) (Rs 35,000 to Rs 60,000), and the doctor decides after a check. No-cost EMI for 6 months is available on braces and implants, subject to bank approval.

q: Is there parking near the clinic?
text: Free parking in the basement for 2 hours with a clinic stamp. Answered from the clinic file

q: Can I just walk in without an appointment?
text: Thank you. I have passed your request to our team, and someone will call you back within 2 working hours to confirm. I cannot confirm a slot myself. Book on the phone or WhatsApp. Cancel or move at least 4 hours before, there is no charge. Later than that, Rs 200. Answered from the clinic file

q: What should I bring for my first visit?
text: Please bring any old X-rays and a list of your medicines.

q: How do you sterilise your instruments?
text: All instruments are sterilised in an autoclave after every patient.

q: Where exactly is the clinic?
text: We are at Plot 21, Road No. 12, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad 500034, opposite the Green Leaf Cafe and above the pharmacy.

q: Do you accept ICICI Lombard insurance?
text: We are cashless with Star Health and Niva Bupa. For other insurers we give a bill you can claim.

q: My gums have been bleeding for an hour and it will not stop
text: Call 98000 00123 now. Heavy bleeding that does not stop, swelling of the face or neck, or trouble breathing: call the emergency number right away and go to the nearest hospital. I have raised an urgent ticket so our team knows. Answered from the clinic file

q: My cheek has swollen up badly since last night
text: Call 98000 00123 now. Heavy bleeding that does not stop, swelling of the face or neck, or trouble breathing: call the emergency number right away and go to the nearest hospital. I have raised an urgent ticket so our team knows. Answered from the clinic file

q: Can I take antibiotics for my gum infection?
text: I am sorry you are going through this. I cannot give medical advice or a diagnosis. A dentist must see you to check it. Would you like to book a visit? Call 040 5550 0123 or WhatsApp 98000 00123, or tell me a day and time and our team will call you back to confirm. Answered from the clinic file

q: There is a black spot on my tooth, is it a cavity?
text: I am not sure about that, and I will not guess. I have passed your question to our team, and someone will call you back within 2 working hours. Answered from the clinic file

q: Can you give me a student discount on cleaning?
text: Sorry, I cannot change the clinic's rules or prices, and I cannot offer a discount. I can tell you the listed prices, timings and doctors. Answered from the clinic file

q: Do you do wisdom tooth extraction?
text: I am not sure about that, and I will not guess. I have passed your question to our team, and someone will call you back within 2 working hours. Answered from the clinic file

q: Is Dr. Sneha Rao available on Wednesday for my 8 year old?
text: Dr. Sneha Rao sees children under 14 on Saturday only, so she is not available on Wednesday. Dr. Meera Nair sees patients Monday to Saturday, and Dr. Imran Qureshi sees patients on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday. Would you like us to book a Saturday slot with Dr. Sneha Rao?
